setlist.title: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (5 reviews): The extended jam at the end is singled out as spectacular; Smoking performance with a great extended ending and soulful Jerry vocal [29][30][31][32][34]
- **Terrapin Station** (3 reviews): Ending has distorted Jerry scale runs and feedback; the reviewer, who was there, wanted it to continue; A short Playin' reprise at the end of the Terrapin jam, which the reviewer had never heard elsewhere [30][31][38]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Reviewer rates this version against any other from the same period; Reviewer has loved this version since the days of trading tapes [27][31]
- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks it is played just as it should be; Driven by Brent and Jerry, with several strong drum fills [29][30]
- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue** (1 review): Reviewer always enjoys a good Baby Blue and rates this one [34]

## Setlist highlights

- **One More Saturday Night Tease**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [39]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-14.sbd.walker-smiller.32501.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: A discontinuity occurs about four seconds into Tennessee Jed [1]
- **gd1984-04-14.senn421.mccue.ford.79652.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1984-04-14.aud.bandrofcheck.34555.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 152 min [3]
- **gd1984-04-14.164499.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 17 songs; 145 min [4]
- **gd84-04-14.neumann.pj.1562.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 17 songs; 136 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [16]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar sounds crisp on this recording; Nice recording where Brent stands out well; a few small dropouts do not detract [27][33]
- **gd1984-04-14.neumann-u87.eaton.miller.90595.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 144 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [19]. Said about its sound: Described as an excellent audience recording [35]

## Around the show

- As a high schooler, the reviewer played this tape loudly on the morning school bus, and everyone went quiet [32]
- Second night of a two-night Hampton run [34]
- Reviewer treats this as night two at Hampton, with the band in high spirits [35]
- Reviewer counts it among favorite spring 1984 shows, alongside the 4/20 show [27]
- Reviewer preferred this night's performance over the previous night, the 13th [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-04-14.sbd.walker-smiller.32501.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Transferred/Edited by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC [1]. Also: Sourced from cassettes provided by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [1]
- **gd1984-04-14.senn421.mccue.ford.79652.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue & unknown; source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421s (shoulder level) > Sony D5 > Sony D5 > Maxell XLII 90s (MAC); MAC > Nakamichi CD2 [azimuth adjusted] > rca/xlr > Lunatec V3 > coax >… [2]. Also: Sennheiser 421 recording patched in My Brother Esau and Tennessee Jed using another source, shnid 32501, edited in Cool Edit Pro [2]
- **gd1984-04-14.aud.bandrofcheck.34555.sbeok.shnf**: source: unknown shotgun mics > Sony D6 > Maxell MX 90s (MC) > Marantz PRD505 (azimuth adjusted) > Marantz Intergrated Stereo Amp MP-68 > SBLive! > Audacity… [3]. Also: Audience cassette recording made with no tape flips during recording; B sides were recorded after fast-forwarding at the break [3]
- **gd1984-04-14.164499.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB)(DFC) Audience Cassettes; Neumann U87 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Recorded by Rob Eaton, who also handled the transfer; Charlie Miller coordinated the release; A Sennheiser 441 source supplies some crowd, the first Tennessee Jed notes, and a short patch in Drums [4]
- **gd84-04-14.neumann.pj.1562.sbeok.shnf**: source: Neumann U-87 mics > Sony D-6 > DAT > CDR [16]
- **gd1984-04-14.neumann-u87.eaton.miller.90595.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Neumann U87 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Dat (48k) D [19]

## Art and photos
